g.text: Model Y on Tesla 2026.38.6.1, 5 Nov 2026 (AEST): every DC discharge session ended by BMS alerts
BMS_a174_SW_Charge_Failure ("Unable to charge") and BMS_a076_SW_Dch_While_Charging ("Weak power source")

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Source: Teslemetry alerts (teslemetry_alerts.get_alerts) and Sigenergy charger telemetry via Home Assistant. Red line: BMS alerts raised. Same alerts did not appear on the Model 3 (2026.26.6.3) during its 2.5 h overnight session.
